title: HM-RAG: Hierarchical Multi-agent Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation

defines.name: HM-RAG
defines.definition: A hierarchical multi-agent multimodal RAG framework that coordinates query decomposition, multi-source retrieval, and decision refinement across heterogeneous data sources.

problem: Conventional single-agent RAG struggles to answer complex queries that require coordinated reasoning over heterogeneous multimodal data sources.
